headline: The ground never pops — Magic Carpet learns to crumble
lede: Blasts, raise mounds and dissolve wounds now unfold over ten ticks instead of teleporting holes into the land: centers accelerate down, mounds swell up, and a shockwave ring heaves outward and settles back to exactly zero — with the final terrain provably identical to the old machine, cell for cell.

notes.text: CRUMBLE (#1694, PR #1695): every ground write queues its deltas on gs.deforms and step() drains the window — honest landing gated at <1e-9 vs the instant machine, fresh worlds never dug by stale ripples, balance sweep still 60/60 seeds.

carpetcheck 138→149 gates: no-pop on the cast tick, ease-in sliver vs linear, rim heave mid-window with zero erosion outside it, regen-clears-the-queue x2, source pins. Three mutants each turned exactly their gates red — and the instant-crater mutant kept BOTH convergence gates green, which is the promise itself.

The README's telekinesis gap was half stale: throw-toppling-the-tower shipped with #1060 and was already gated. The line now records what's true, and multi-carry — an unverifiable 1994-memory claim — is out of spec, not a gap.

Slot-b note: the warden target #1690 was refused (slot a live on it), so the never-dry rung scored the shelf and picked MAGIC CARPET — POLISH #1694 filed, claimed and shipped the same session. Polish pass for QA follows as #1697: the crumble still needs its sound.
